The ladder is course < medrese < köşk < platform; a hide records the level its hider acted at, and one recorded by nobody counts as the lowest level that could have hidden it. Who acts at which level is the catalogue's: whoever holds a code that hides the item where it sits (`week.hide` for a week, `course.hide` and `madrasah.course_hide` for a course, `kosk.manage` or `platform.kosk_edit` for a köşk) acts at the level of the highest one they hold, and SYSTEM_ADMIN at the platform. Someone who holds none answers 403 (ARCHIVE_FORBIDDEN); a lower level than the one that hid it answers 403 (ARCHIVE_RESTORE_LEVEL) naming both. Written to the audit log (`<entity>.restore`). viewerMayDecide.description: Whether the caller may approve or reject this application with `POST /courses/:id/enrollments/:userId/approve` and `DELETE /courses/:id/enrollments/:userId`: the course's müderris, its köşk's nazım, or the başnazım. A başmüderris who is none of these gets 403 from those routes, so the row shows no buttons for them

nazirCount.description: "{n} medrese nazırı": the nazırs held, the başmüderris not among them

courseCount.description: "{n} medrese dersi": the medrese's courses that are not hidden, drafts included

hostingKosks.description: "Barındırma hakkı olan köşkler": the same list as `GET /madrasahs/:id/hosting-kosks`

upcomingSessions.description: "Yaklaşan celseler": the live sessions of the medrese's published courses in the next 7 days, soonest first. Cancelled and hidden sessions, and hidden and draft courses, are left out, so the count in the greeting is this array's length

pendingApplicationCount.description: Every pending application across the medrese's courses; the greeting's "{m} başvuru". `pendingApplications` carries at most 50 of them

pendingCourseCount.description: In how many courses they wait: "{n} başvuru · {m} derste"

pendingApplications.description: "Bekleyen başvurular": newest first, at most 50. The count above is the true number when there are more

name.description: Null when the account never signed in to tedrisat.

role.description: The role the hider holds or held where the item sits (KOSK_NAZIM, MEDRESE_BASMUDERRIS, MEDRESE_NAZIR, MUDERRIS, DERS_NAZIR); null for SYSTEM_ADMIN or when none is on record. The client words it.

title.description: The hidden thing's own title or name.

courseId.description: The course a week or a session belongs to.

weekNumber.description: Of a week, and of the week a session is in.

weekCount.description: Of a course: its live weeks.

sessionCount.description: Of a week: its live sessions.

studentCount.description: Of a course: its enrolled talebe.

hiddenLevel.description: The level the hider acted at (course, madrasah, kosk, platform); a row hidden before it was recorded counts as the lowest level that could have hidden it. Only that level or above brings it back.

canRestore.description: Whether the caller may bring it back (Geri al): they hold a code that hides it where it sits and act at the hider's level or above. False when a higher level hid it. A hidden parent still answers 409 on restore.

total.description: All hidden items matching, not just this page.

all.description: Every hidden week and session of the course.

total.description: All hidden items matching, not just this page.

counts.description: The tabs' numbers: everything hidden in the course, whatever `types` says.

courses.description: Courses that go with it (a köşk's).

recordings.description: Lesson recordings; 0 until recordings are stored.

hiddenLevel.description: The level that hid it; null while it is shown.

canRestore.description: Whether the caller may bring the medrese back (`POST /madrasahs/:id/restore`): it is hidden, they hold `madrasah.hide` or `platform.madrasah_edit` on it and act at the level that hid it or above.

total.description: All hidden items matching `types`, not just this page.

madrasah.description: The medrese itself: the page cannot read a hidden medrese anywhere else it may not open.

counts.description: The tabs' numbers: everything hidden in the medrese, whatever `types` says.

outcome.description: PENDING waits; PUBLISHED and REJECTED are answered.

decksTotal.description: Every shown deck of the köşk, not the page

proposalsTotal.description: Every proposal nobody has answered, not the page

proposalId.description: The proposal this deck answers; it is accepted together with the deck.

courseId.description: One of the proposer's courses in this köşk.

madrasahId.description: The medrese the request is sent from

title.description: The course the medrese asks to open

courseId.description: The course opened from the request in this köşk; the request is accepted with it.

openKosk.description: The viewer may open a köşk (the başnazım only): the page shows the 'Köşk aç' button.

appeals.description: İtirazlar: the appeal model comes with a later phase, so the count is 0 for a viewer who would see it

permanentBanRequests.description: Kalıcı yasak talepleri: the request model comes with a later phase, so the count is 0 for a viewer who would see it

inactiveMadrasah.description: Of them, the passive ones (no başmüderris)

course.description: Courses that are not hidden; null: not shown to a nazım

enrolledStudents.description: Distinct talebe enrolled in a course that is not hidden; null: not shown to a nazım

koskName.description: The köşk of a course; null for a köşk or a medrese

courseTitle.description: The course of a course ban; null for a köşk ban

greetingName.description: The viewer's given name for the greeting; null when unknown

latestApplications.description: The newest waiting applications, three at most; null: not shown

latestDeckRequests.description: The newest waiting deck requests, three at most; null: not shown

inactiveScopes.description: Passive scopes, oldest first, three at most; null: not shown

inactiveScopeCount.description: How many passive scopes there are in all; null: not shown

latestBans.description: The newest open bans, three at most; null: not shown

nazirOf.description: Medreses the caller is başmüderris or nazır of, from their live role assignments.

scopeName.description: The köşk's or medrese's name, the course's title

roles.description: The caller's roles held in exactly this scope

permissions.description: What the caller holds in this scope, sorted, as the permission engine computes it: role defaults and live grants, a grant only while a role covers it. A köşk's or medrese's entry includes the course work held across its courses. Codes every signed-in caller holds (viewing, enrolling) are left out. Policies and passive scopes are not applied: the routes still refuse what they close.

assignments.description: The caller's live role assignments, as GET /me/assignments

permissions.description: One entry for every scope the caller holds a role in, and for every scope below a role they hold a grant in. The realm role (başnazım) holds everything and is not a list of codes: it adds no entry, so a başnazım with no role rows gets none.

kunye.description: İlmî künye. Null until the person chooses one.

fullName.description: The name from the account, as shown on Hesap

courses.description: Titles of the published courses the caller is enrolled in or has completed

fullName.description: Present only while the owner shows it

city.description: Present only while the owner shows it

about.description: Present only while the owner shows it
